notes.title: v[1.1.006] Object Snapping
notes.content:
Object Snapping
You can use the object snapping feature while placing store racks, warehouse racks, decorations, cash registers, speakers, and fitting rooms.

(You can disable it in the Options - Gameplay settings.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/cc471e5a5c8e7b815186da6f3acec5a70c5a8914.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/ddfd983e10924dc818147ad5a61f7625a4654679.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/52d4caff4d773e761f0bbbd3f5b9d9edfbe45591.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/4f970db825af9addbb43a5f8bf12407c73af506f.jpg"]

If you want to use the object snapping feature on wall racks, you should know that they are only functional with other wall racks.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/5974ca9b3ac9b27742035a12aad07cc5f92b7ece.jpg"]

Align Snapping Objects

If you "Hold Left Shift (by default)" while placing an object, you can align the object.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/d30740990243679f5323d45dc27be460641bb8c5.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/d4ccecd2188765e1c933a2a0be3b90f5d71dc9ba.jpg"]

If you don't want to use the object snapping feature, you can disable it in the Options - Gameplay settings.

notes.title: v[1.1.001] New Version (Online co-op mode, thieves, cleaning, online orders)
notes.content:
New Version

You can select the version after you click "Play" on Steam.
There will be two options:
1- New Version: This version includes all the new features like online co-op mode, inventory slots, online orders, thieves, cleaning, security guard, janitor, and customer review score. Older save files are incompatible with this version.
2- Old Version: There won't be any updates for the old version but you can still play this version with your old save files.

Here are the update notes for the "New Version":

1- Online Co-Op Mode
The online co-op mode is here! You can play with your friends.
Share the duties with your friends in co-op mode (for up to 4 players).
The more players in the store, the more demanding customers will visit your store.
Also, you can go solo and manage everything in the store. You can invite your friends anytime if you change your mind.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/6381a35d4b504da896140c720c77fc0342f8df6c.jpg

* If you select "Single Player", you can play the tutorials but nobody can join your game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/e13f1ae24c0a977c6db8e0f4fe9a55b0aae814c0.jpg

* If you leave all boxes unchecked, everybody can join your game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/66f270b814ad33704108c3da0e003f8ce63d0a1f.jpg

* If you select "Friends Only", your friends can join your game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/c4a3d4bf2cd6be10625f2b4feca0694d1d47ae61.jpg

***You can change your preferences when you load your game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/e5dabaced3fef028b0f2784a18c4deb60f4c1be4.jpg

2- Profile
You can select and customize your character in the Main Menu - Profile section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/05274727f49f7b5ed897fe3fc738ec8a0fa271fc.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/692cc7f9acd3b3c081fe6b249046821ac0b04826.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/46be85abb74cdd7421ffa8c80bc176d74d9378ea.jpg

3- Inventory Slots
You have 5 slots to keep more boxes with you.
You can switch between the slots with the mouse wheel.
You can also carry a mop in one of the slots.
A mop can be used to clean the store and hit the thieves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/63cfd773c29089938ba7ec797c540a8390ce1889.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/d874d0d46af346cdd6a966e7135ecde3b1bc479f.jpg

4- Online Orders
When you receive an online order, you'll get a notification on the left part of the screen.
Then, you can go to the "Online Orders" section on your desktop to accept the order.
When you accept an online order, you can deliver the required products to the post office until the day ends.
If not, all orders will be canceled automatically the very next day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/bfe2c503667553e6edf5526a38181400d3210592.jpg

How to complete online orders?

First, you should accept the online order on Desktop-Online Orders.
Second, you can pin the required products by pressing the button on the top-right corner of the received online order.
Third, you can add the required products to your slots (use the mouse wheel to switch between the slots).
Finally, go to the Post Office and click LMB (the same way you place products in the racks) to put them into the post office box.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/a0869098ad7b0ec6f67c4ddb6ae032dffef8b714.jpg

5- Thieves & Security Guard & Anti-Theft Alarm Systems
(If you don't want to deal with the thieves, please disable it from the Options-Gameplay settings.)

Thieves steal your boxes from delivery areas, warehouses, or store entrances.
You can get your box back by hitting the thief with your mop. (You can buy a mop from the Market-Equipment section.)
(They'll leave the box and run away when you hit them with your mop.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/170c71ba5b1dd81121048d30a85fdd42293264a8.jpg

When a thief is around, your security guard will chase the thief, and you'll get a notification on the top-left corner of the screen: "Security Guard is chasing a thief right now".
Please remember that sometimes two thieves visit you at the same time. When your security guard is chasing a thief, it's better to check around (if there is any other thief).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/922123ac1f5980fe6e43a643f1aa19a6f8c5272c.jpg

You earn level points when you hit the thieves.
(The higher the store level, the higher the level points from hitting the thieves)
You'll earn level points when your security guard hits the thieves, too.
You can hire a security guard from the Desktop-Workers section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/1d0ffff9f399006bb81f44876843eac8b0a3b624.jpg

When you reach the required level and have enough money, you can purchase anti-theft alarm systems. These security protection systems automatically detect any theft attempt and notify you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/8920ac08dd084d10d7d243ff562cb5da51d1eb7a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/1c857005dd6148e80c3ee7456b859751276b34b4.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/95509eb21e5728b698fcfaf5d33bcf8b9e6a22b8.jpg

6- Cleaning & Janitor
(If you don't want to deal with the cleaning, please disable it from the Options-Gameplay settings.)

Some customers will leave dirt in the store. You'd better clean the store with your mop. Otherwise, your customers will complain. Each cleaning action gives a level point.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/9c28ced4df19fb04163aae810d984e512dd00408.jpg

You can see the total level points coming from cleaning in the daily report.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/704f8e605f1cdcdc8e42ccb50b39eac3be3fe3b4.jpg

When a customer leaves any dirt in the store, your janitor will go to clean it. You can hire a janitor from the Desktop-Workers section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/72043272578ae6371f9647473b397654509ff8a4.jpg

You'll earn level points when your janitor cleans any dirt, too.
Please remember that you may still get some penalty-level points if your janitor can't clean the dirt before a customer steps on it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/7db85e439a039fb981c7f83976907d696ba8ce01.jpg

7- Customer Review Score
Customers rate your store during the checkout process.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/8bfb2d4da12e2de31e9f0cba05b7613dc0828976.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/b541b69c817f39304d5828fef160c01d191009c3.jpg

You get extra level points if you complete a day with higher than 4 points.
If your review score is 4.00, you get 10 level points.
If you're above 4.00, you get more level points (10+). The higher the review score, the higher the level points.
If your review score is 5.00, you get 25 level points.

You can see how many level points you earn in the daily report.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/509e3539685e799c9e6bec2f035605026699243b.jpg

You can check your current score on Desktop-Customer Reviews. The current score is today's score. It'll reset at the end of the day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/ea81d3f18cb83fae714300ce3c28dc6b8e2cca67.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/64ef14b4ddee5500f5ab6e3a45dc2292ebf9054e.jpg

How to increase customer satisfaction?

Avoid long fitting room queues
Avoid long checkout queues
Keep the store clean
Set product prices by considering the recommended prices
Let your customers find all products in the store racks
Place some decorations to provide a beautiful atmosphere
Place some speakers and let your customers listen to some relaxing music in your store


8- Customer Interactions
You can click on any customer's head and get a short feedback about your store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/bbdc79e5dfd140e0f4a09293b77786e9b8c79d8e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/2e601ee7bc4eb4ce7cb0963eafc1baad7bf64bd0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/bd92c0b4af298a3693e818d535436348ac4a1d83.jpg

9- Increased Box and Rack Capacities
Most of the box and rack capacities are increased.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/87756257676b143a278d20e7a3bf257bb0921e05.jpg

10- Box-to-box Interaction

You can place the same type of products from your box (in your hand) into another box on the ground or a warehouse rack by clicking LMB.
It's also possible to take the same type of products from the box on the ground or the warehouse rack to the box in your hand by clicking RMB.


11- No need to search for an empty box in the trash

When you have an available slot, you can take any products from a rack by clicking RMB.
As soon as you right-click, the required box type will be spawned on your hand to help you take the products from the rack.


12- New Cash Register: Small Bills On The Left
There is a new cash register in the Market-Equipment section.
This cash register has small bills on the left.
Bills order -> Small bills are on the left

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/d3221a6b960121d820698098135a3aac9cc6188f.jpg

13- Options: Payment Type Selection
You can select the payment type in the Options-Gameplay-Payment Type.
There are three payment types:

Default -> Customers will use "card or cash" during the checkout process
Card Payment -> Customers will use "cards" only during the checkout process
Cash Payment -> Customers will use "cash" only during the checkout process


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/76943b1ac3a182a2d1dcf0e3771256f269999554.jpg

14- Pause the Stockers
You can send your stockers to a break. Meanwhile, you can design your store and warehouse. When you finish your design, you can make your stockers start working.

Please go to the Desktop-Workers section. There is a new button (that appears when there is a minimum of one stocker hired).
Press the button to send your stockers to a break.
Press the button again to end their break and make them work.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/50b65afdf306807291bb9e4ec7c82cf3f7123d05.jpg

15- Speakers & Music Player
You can buy the speakers from the Market-Equipment section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/09c835dd537030541dc3d6169bc9bd0d10f12e7d.jpg

Once you place a speaker in your store, you'll be able to play the music in the store using the Desktop-Music Player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/9ac7dc4221c356402732a3d9103b3d19e4e5e5b5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/9f6b58a7a0cc4c3ccebf32d80b0476179a45722f.jpg

16- Set Price - Filter Button
There is a filter button on Set Price.
Filters are All, Price Changed Products, Lower Than Recommended, Higher Than Recommended.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/8a8e064498ddac598f5fb14e4a73226ee013cbcd.jpg

Price Changed Products filter will help you easily check the daily changes at the day start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/e6fbb2f2a0c89d54ecf84dc648cf071823cc60cf.jpg

17- Decoration Placement (Above the wall racks)
You can place the decorations above the wall racks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/6e04686bff6230c7bbbf31fd4e57025b8f880b23.jpg

18- Computer/Tablet - Open the store
You can open/close your store on your computer and tablet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/3ae1237fe320b76bf333586ef700d08a143b3c84.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/e958f6c3cc1107f4346c984c7637ae656d47d971.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/c2d05e1f01a9396ad05d14359b91046e4d6eca08.jpg

19- New Racks
3 new racks added:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/53555e193974435939467af011dd3a3db8e61975.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/4f7085afc521a3357c8e0842731911c78c487be8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/371025a7ed72005f880a9816bb3ef8ac733d72ab.jpg

20- New Decorations
14 new decorations added:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/aee13ab41fb4e9a4124bb83bbd4ca65c3ade2b4d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/5e1dfe0e9f1769ff9c102e97aca1e77e21265b07.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/65d7801a3d6f8203e1f565d34ede9ad00cd387d3.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/2d605c6d9b48a325829dc8f13e27d60eff02999e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/299b0bb9f5f9f9b6c1b62c9b1d1dc5e853a72421.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/0d26229976928eeb032079674a899c35163b9798.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/27ef62cdb94b79fb62bf3b981ba18f525b232fc4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/37c1c7654a3eeadcf97e16c901b569d313731c5f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/0d411d0dda7e941f77c6f7a91aede1de5c528db9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/9a056a166900072a419d63e82b64fe9d906ea515.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/b583463f623eed1680bbdc02921c46b621559185.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/e7d01b4c0376116920b753d6cb21480bcd0c2cef.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/d9293ba2ff07f1bf567b68d9f5f88d55d1e7f5da.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/582fb9f90e2f7565e51e9c27caee0ea15437d079.png

21- New Shortcut - Check Inventory

You can hold the Z-key (by default) to check your inventory.
When you hold the Z-key (by default), you can see how many products are in your store and how many products are in your stock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/6fb4c0b679eb7f8bc09ac906f4f98d011bf0e089.jpg

As you can see in the screenshot:
* There are 16 products on the store racks.
* This product's tagged store racks are for a capacity of 20 products
* There are 3 products in your stock.

It's Z-key by default. You can change it from the Options-Controls.
Keybinding:  Options -> Controls -> Check Inventory

There are 5 ways to use this shortcut:
1- You can check your inventory when you hover on a store rack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/d935339565187bd905e7d22aa4071d67d3cb4539.jpg

2- You can check your inventory when you hover on an empty store rack (but tagged with a product).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/e74ecf3ec97b54e8169bd1ae77e2afca3a60fb2d.jpg

3- You can check your inventory when you hover on a warehouse rack spot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/d75eeff22449c5448610310db152df70779420cc.jpg

4- You can check your inventory when you hover on an empty warehouse rack spot (but tagged with a product).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/4ffae968f5b2bc07b335b8a0bb89c9f556982719.jpg

5- You can check your inventory when you hover on a box on the ground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/8e6445b9922b742f5f0c8b2deb67ec4296d5cdea.jpg

22- Contracts - Level Points
Each signed contract gives level points depending on the contract price.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/99f07d2812b590037e94c46db690dc96b04db5d7.jpg

23- New Shortcut - Add To Cart
You can add any product to your shopping cart using the T-key (by default).
There are 5 ways to use this shortcut:

When you hover on a store rack
When you hover on an empty store rack (but tagged with a product)
When you hover on a warehouse rack spot.
When you hover on an empty warehouse rack spot (but tagged with a product).
When you hover on a box on the ground


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/3600dee2fe1d28ee75267f5907d2978debc6365e.jpg

24- Highlighting Same Products

When you hold the X-key (by default), the same products (as you have in your hand) will be highlighted in the racks and boxes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/73748708b9455039a45522987b8642a24ec325db.jpg

notes.title: v[1.0.60] Training for Cashiers and Stockers
notes.content:
1- Training for Cashiers and Stockers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/bc964cf8c2089583fb85f53e41731d7eb198313a.jpg

Cashier Training -> Faster Checkout Process

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/e2ae6344cf191dd62688c48b30c7a46b940cdefe.jpg

Stocker Training -> Faster Rack-Filling
Stocker Training -> Faster Walking

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/cd5b419785a3c7b8aa9b7cb825919d6a9b25d938.jpg

Desktop-Workers: Your workers' current training levels are shown with stars. Also, each training will raise their salaries, and you can see their daily wages here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/4b100168800a8d79f970a269f3a1c1e8c24d8221.jpg

2- Recommended Retail Price Buttons
You can click to set a product's price as the recommended retail price on the Desktop-Set Price section or on the price tag of the store rack.

This is on the Desktop-Set Price section:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/c50f13d3af8bca17a9a61dc33cfbfc6d9399cabc.jpg

This is on the price tag of the store rack:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/1af5343ea209bdf62eb2a47fbf4299ff9d07e249.jpg

3- New Walls
There are five new wall options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/c2efb37d60cb85987cedcb356ee052c3ebdee43b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/41b3c419954e8e0c594c52f27d955b82427c94a4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/601934a2b864e1b0298420516224549a418c30b9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/74570ebb289281de08548466836efe69d29c9fab.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099351/926f5ecaad32947b36e6d4db90f17fc22043fd37.png

notes.title: v[1.0.36] Stocker Workflow Selection
notes.content:
Stocker Workflow Selection

There are two workflow options for the stockers:
(can be changed from the Workers section on your desktop). 

Stocker Workflow - 1
Stockers place the boxes on their tagged spots in the warehouse racks. If the stockers can't find the same tagged spot, they place the boxes randomly into the free spots in the warehouse racks.

Stocker Workflow - 2
Stockers place the boxes on their tagged spots in the warehouse racks. If the stockers can't find the same tagged spot, they throw the boxes around the delivery area. They never place the boxes if there aren't any same tagged spots in the warehouse racks.
